desc: Establish that operation order is irrelevant and that an optimal solution uses at most two type-2 operations.
Derive a non-quadratic algorithm for the two-type-2 case, including reconstruction of the selected pair.
Correct endpoint semantics for interval containment and coverage.
Add and test the cost-2 type-1-plus-type-2 case.
Combine cost-1, cost-2, and cost-3 cases with operation-label reconstruction.
Exhaustively compare the implementation with a brute-force solver using semantic validation and identify genuine correctness counterexamples.
Prove correctness of both three-operation searches, especially the candidate reduction.
Validate impossible instances, duplicate intervals, endpoint cases, and large sparse inputs.
Produce the final memory-efficient implementation and semantic validation summary.
